Settings & tools


      
Appearance & goals

      

        
        
      

      
      


      

        
Install the app

        
Add Field Notes to your home screen so it opens full-screen like an app.

        

      


      
Your progress

      
Progress lives in this browser only. Export a backup before clearing site data or switching phones; import merges it back (all completed lessons are kept, along with the higher XP total).

      

        
        
        
      

      


      

        
Read aloud

        
Uses a voice already on your device (an Australian English one if it has it). Nothing is sent anywhere.

        
      


      
Lesson feedback

      
The 👍 / 👎 buttons on each lesson are saved in this browser. Export them as a spreadsheet-ready CSV (unclear lessons first) to see which explanations to rewrite next.

      

        
      

      


      
Stored R engine

      
After the first visit, R and its packages are kept on this device so later visits start faster and can work offline. If something seems stuck, clear them and they will download again next time.

      

        
      

      


      
Self-test

      
Runs each lesson's setup, solution and check in R on this device and lists any that fail. It needs R to be ready and installs each unit's packages as it goes, so the first full run can take a few minutes. Keep this panel open while it runs.
